features.title: Agent toolkit page
features.summary: A main panel (sidebar → Agent Toolkit: Capabilities; main-tabs opens it as a tab) showing what the agent can use in one thread: tools with source, owner, read-only marker and preset restrictions; plugin API methods and agent tools; loaded plugins with versions, state and settings links; MCP servers with status and tools; skills with Host-reported origin, provider and invocation mode; and Memory's start block and note counts. Search and source filters narrow every section. Skill origin is never inferred from filesystem paths, and Host paths are not sent to the browser. It replaces the Tools tab of Settings › Built-in plugins.
failureModes: Without a dshx Host serving the registry, the page says the catalog is unavailable instead of listing nothing.
Without MCP servers or memory loaded, their section says so; the rest still renders.

A registry served by an older dshx lacks read-only, restriction, skill-source and invocation fields; the page omits missing tool badges, labels unknown skill provenance as other, and assumes the person can invoke a skill.
Modern Hosts do not forward absolute skill paths, and the Agent Toolkit decoder drops legacy path fields before rendering.

features.title: Open the agent toolkit from the command palette
features.summary: The command palette's “Open the agent toolkit” opens the page about the thread the palette was opened from.
reach: fill textbox "Describe what you want to build, / commands, @ files or sessions" "Toolkit thread"
failureModes: Without a thread the page falls back to global tools.

telemetry.reason: Client-only: Open the agent toolkit from the command palette renders browser state and starts no Host work of its own.
